QuestInfo.name: A White Christmas
QuestInfo.0: A penguin dressed like Santa has appeared in every major town!\r\nFind out what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: A penguin has requested your help.\r\n\r\nGo see if there's a penguin in town dressed like Santa.
QuestInfo.2: Ah, now that the tree is decorated, the holidays feel complete!

0.0: Hiya! I'm Small Beak and I live in Happyville!\rMy friends and I are making a White Christmas Tree.\r\n#L0##bA White Christmas Tree?#l\n#k
0.1: Yeah, when we finish it,\rlots of #i04310011# Snow Crystals will form\rand we'll really have a white Christmas!\r\n#L0##bThen I'll help you make the Christmas Tree!#l\n#k
0.2: That's the spirit! If you want to help,\rjust come see me in any nearby town!

no.0: Don't you want a white Christmas?

1.0: You made it! Good thing, too.\rSee, monsters have stolen all the #i04001473# tree ornaments,\rso we're low on things to dress up the tree with...
1.1: If you find any #i04001473# tree ornaments while hunting monsters,\rbring them to me and I'll send you to\r\n#bWhite Christmas Hill#k, where my friends are decorating the tree!

yes.0: You'll see a winter bear when you arrive at White Christmas Hill.\rJust give the ornaments to him!
